summary.content:
Today's selection covers 95 articles from 9 trusted sources, including 66 on Artificial Intelligence and 20 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: Rogue Anthropic AI agent gave police fake tip in unsolved murder case
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: FBI Arrests Founder of Ransomware Negotiation Firm
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights ransomware, data breaches, malware
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, The Verge, NY Times Tech, Krebs on Security, TechCrunch and others
• **Fresh Content**: 31 articles published in the last 24 hours
